st.headline: Rupiah’s drop to record low spurs Bank Indonesia intervention
st.teaser: The rupiah has come under renewed pressure as the dollar strengthened overnight.
fullText: JAKARTA – The Indonesian rupiah fell to an all-time low, adding pressure on authorities to contain a recent sell-off that also hit the nation’s stocks and bonds.

The central bank said it is intervening in the offshore non-deliverable forwards, domestic non-deliverable forwards and spot markets, as well as via government bond purchases in the secondary market to stabilise the rupiah, Asia’s worst-performing currency in 2026.

“Bank Indonesia remains present in the market to maintain the stability of the rupiah exchange rate, ensuring it aligns with its fundamental value,” the central bank’s executive director of Monetary and Securities Management Erwin Hutapea said in a statement on Nov 12.
The rupiah weakened as much as 0.5% to 18,241 per US dollar on Nov 12, falling past the previous record low of 18,190 seen in early June. The 10-year bond yield climbed four basis points to 7.66%.

The rupiah has come under renewed pressure as the dollar strengthened overnight on expectations that the Federal Reserve would resume raising interest rates in December. Investor sentiment remains fragile after MSCI in October unveiled a proposal to reclassify Indonesia as a standalone market, compounding a host of concerns already weighing on Indonesian assets, including political uncertainty.

“The rupiah continues to face relatively poor investor sentiment due to the confluence of unfavourable news headlines and the shift in the outlook for the US inflation and Fed policy,” said Homin Lee, senior macro strategist at Lombard Odier in Singapore.
“MSCI reclassification risk and Bank Indonesia’s relatively slow tightening cycle are also deterring value-seeking investors for the rupiah,” he added.

The rupiah has weakened more than 8% against the US dollar in 2026. Bank Indonesia has said it remains vigilant about market developments and is monitoring capital outflows following the MSCI announcement.
Local regulators have stepped up efforts to improve the equity market’s transparency and surveillance to avert MSCI’s double-downgrade threat, with the decision to be announced by the end of June.
They fined companies and individuals involved in stock manipulations, excluded tightly held shares from the benchmark index and enhanced shareholders’ affiliation information.
Goldman Sachs Group estimated about US$5.6 billion (S$7.2 billion) of passive outflows in the event the country’s stocks are removed from MSCI’s indexes.

The rupiah was also weighed down by a stronger dollar, which climbed to an 18-month high on Nov 11 as traders began pricing in a small chance of a half-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December following hawkish comments from officials and hotter-than-expected inflation data.
Meanwhile, renewed concerns over political uncertainty are also hurting markets after Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka’s resignation.
Gibran, the son of former President Joko Widodo, had faced growing calls from politicians for his impeachment over questions about his educational credentials.

“The optics around the resignation are negative, the politics remain messy and investor sentiment is still fragile,” though there should be little fundamental spillover from this, said Galvin Chia, an emerging Asia strategist at Societe Generale. BLOOMBERG

cna.headline: Dakar Youth Games test waters for Russia's comeback
cna.teaser: Dakar Youth Games test waters for Russia's comeback
fullText: DAKAR, Nov 12 : Russia's national anthem played during the medal ceremony on the first day of the Youth Olympics at a pool in Senegal's capital Dakar, a small but symbolic victory in Moscow's quest to return to the international sporting stage.
The International Olympic Committee (IOC) suspended the Russian Olympic Committee (ROC) in 2023 after the ROC recognised regional Olympic councils in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine.

Two years later, however, the IOC said youth athletes should not be held accountable for the actions of their governments, urging federations to readmit Russian youth athletes to international events without any restrictions.
The fruits of that guidance have been on display during the Games in Dakar, with 13 Russian athletes competing in nine events, including swimming, judo and skateboarding.
"Of course, I was happy, how could I not be? I was proud of myself and of my country," the teenager told Reuters last week before winning another gold in the women's 50-metre butterfly.
Not everyone in the audience was pleased, however. One spectator refused to stand for the Russian anthem.
"Europeans, and in particular the European Union, are fiercely opposed to this return," Jean-Baptiste Guegan, a French expert on the geopolitics of sport, told Reuters.
National federations in countries including Norway, Denmark and Sweden have said their teams will not play against Russia in international competitions.
The Russian government sees Russians' participation as a political victory.

In a post on Telegram last month, Sports Minister Mikhail Degtyarev called the Olympics in Senegal "an important step towards the full return of all Russian sport to the international stage without any restrictions".
Russian athletes competed as neutrals at the 2024 Paris Olympics and the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Games.
The IOC provisionally lifted its ban on the ROC in July in a further step towards Russia's return to international sport.
But it still needs to decide whether Russia can display its flag and colours and have its anthem played at the Los Angeles 2028 Games.

Sanctions-hit Moscow is trying to convince each international sports federation to allow its athletes to compete. Federations for sports including aquatics and judo have moved to loosen or remove restrictions on Russian athletes, while athletics still bans them from participating.

In Senegal, as in other African countries, many people have a more favourable view of Russia than in the West. Among young Africans who describe Russia as an influential country, 83 per cent say that influence is positive, according to a survey released in July by the Johannesburg-based Ichikowitz Family Foundation.

This has reduced the likelihood of organised political opposition or public criticism, according to Spencer Harris, professor of sport governance and sport policy at the University of Colorado, Colorado Springs.
The Youth Olympic Games also receive little global attention compared to the other Olympic competitions, he said.
The Dakar Games have given officials within the IOC and beyond an opportunity to test public reactions to a potential change in status for Russian athletes.

"Many of these leaders appear interested in finding pathways for Russian athletes to gradually return to international competition, while still balancing the political and legal complexities surrounding Russia's invasion of Ukraine," Harris told Reuters.

listening.title: New Green Corridors Connect Urban Parks Across Singapore
listening.transcript: Singapore has launched a fresh network of park connectors designed to boost biodiversity and enhance urban walking routes. Residents in the heartlands can now travel seamlessly between nature reserves without leaving shaded pathways. Authorities hope these green corridors will encourage active commuting while preserving local flora. Initial feedback from weekend joggers has been overwhelmingly positive.

economistArticle.title: The Monoculture Trap in High-Finance
paras: For hedge fund managers accustomed to outsmarting the market, the past month offered a brutal lesson in financial concentration. Quantitative models failed, macro strategies foundered, and stock-pickers found themselves trapped in identical portfolios. The source of this collective misery was not a surprise systemic crash, but an uncomfortable truth: almost every profitable trade in recent quarters has rested on a single underlying wager on artificial intelligence.

When semiconductor giants and cloud providers stumbled mid-season, the resulting pullbacks reverberated across the global financial landscape. Funds that had quietly doubled down on tech supply chains suffered rapid drawdowns, while traditional diversification strategies yielded negligible defense. The market revealed itself to be far narrower than benchmark indexes had previously suggested.

This environment highlights the subtle peril of momentum trading in an era dominated by technological hype. As capital poured into a handful of megacap tech equities, alternative asset classes were starved of liquidity and attention. Value stocks languished, commodities traded sideways, and foreign exchange strategies ran into unprecedented volatility caused by interest rate recalibrations.

Crucially, the episode exposes structural flaws in modern risk assessment tools. Many risk models had registered these crowded tech trades as distinct and uncorrelated simply because the companies operated in different sub-sectors or geographies. Yet when market sentiment inverted, liquidity evaporated in lockstep, demonstrating that thematic overlap matters far more than traditional sector classifications.

Looking forward, fund managers face a difficult dilemma. Abandoning the AI theme completely risks missing out on generational productivity gains, yet staying crowded leaves portfolios exposed to sharp sentiment shifts. Until institutional capital discovers viable growth narratives outside of Silicon Valley, hedge funds will remain vulnerable to the brutal whims of a single crowded trade.
economistArticle.cn:
对于习惯于耍聪明战胜市场的对冲基金经理来说，过去一个月在金融集中度方面给他们上了残忍的一课。量化模型失效，宏观策略挫败，选股人发现自己陷于完全同质化的投资组合中。这片共同痛苦的根源并非一场突如其来的系统性崩溃，而是一个令人不安的事实：近几季度几乎所有盈利的交易，都建立在对人工智能这单一方向的押注之上。

当半导体巨头和云服务提供商在季中遭遇挫折时，随之而来的回调在全球金融格局中掀起回响。悄悄对科技供应链加倍押注的基金遭遇了快速的资产回撤，而传统的分散投资策略几乎没有起到防御作用。市场所展现出的狭窄程度，远比基准指数先前所提示的更为严重。

这一环境突显了在由科技炒作主导的时代进行顺势/动量交易的隐蔽危险。随着资本涌入少数超大型科技股，其他资产类别极度匮乏流动性和关注度。价值股陷入停滞，大宗商品横盘整理，外汇策略则因利率重新校准而遭遇前所未有的波动。

关键在于，这一事件暴露了现代风险评估工具的结构性缺陷。许多风险模型曾将这些拥挤的科技交易标注为独立且互不相关的，仅仅因为这些公司处于不同的子行业或地理区域。然而，当市场情绪逆转时，流动性同步蒸发，这表明主题重合度比传统的行业分类重要得多。

展望未来，基金经理面临着艰难的困境。彻底放弃人工智能主题面临着错失代际生产力红利的风险，然而保持拥挤又使投资组合暴露于剧烈的情绪转变之中。在机构资本于硅谷之外找到可行的增长叙事之前，对冲基金将继续易受单一拥挤交易残酷无情冲刷的影响。

gems.s: Abandoning the AI theme completely risks missing out on generational productivity gains, yet staying crowded leaves portfolios exposed to sharp sentiment shifts.
gems.why: This sentence utilizes a balanced parallel structure ('Abandoning X risks... yet staying Y leaves...') to articulate a classic strategic dilemma succinctly. 句子使用了平衡的平行句式（“放弃X面临……风险，然而保持Y又使……暴露于……”），简洁明了地阐述了一个经典的战略困境。

gems.s: Value stocks languished, commodities traded sideways, and foreign exchange strategies ran into unprecedented volatility caused by interest rate recalibrations.
gems.why: This sentence employs tricolon (a series of three parallel clauses) to vividly describe the broad collateral damage across multiple asset classes. 句中使用三段式（三个平行从句）生动地描写了多个资产类别所遭受的广泛波及。
